post.title: Why You Were Taught Money Is Evil #shorts
post.description: Psychologists call them money scripts: beliefs about money we absorb as kids. Klontz & Britt (2012) found people with "money avoidance" beliefs tend to have lower income and net worth. Comment the money rule your family taught you.
